notes.title: Shadowveil Patch 1.1.1 - The Last Expedition
notes.content:

Welcome to 1.1.1 update brings additional QOL and bugfixes, but this will be the last patch for the entire game.

It’s been a privilege to work on Shadowveil, its been an absolute blast to take part of the Legend of the Five Rings universe, and the team eternally grateful to you, our community for supporting us in creating and launching Shadowveil.
 
Thank you for playing Shadowveil: Legend of the Five RIngs, and hopefully we see each other soon in another context. 
Take care and goodbye.

With love,
The team at Palindrome Interactive

notes.title: Shadowveil Patch 1.1 - Closing a chapter
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Samurai[/h1]
My name is Filip and I’m the Game Director of Shadowveil.

Welcome to 1.1 our first major update which should make the game it's best, listen to the video where I also talk about some important news, so please watch the entire video.

[previewyoutube=7oMtnnuVcwo;full][/previewyoutube]
This patch should help the game feel more complete, give more build/experimentation opportunities and hopefully just feel better!

However with patch 1.1 also comes the closing of a chapter.
Patch 1.1 will be the last content patch for the game. We have one additional patch planned, 1.1.1 that brings additional QOL and bugfixes, but that will be the last patch for the entire game.

It’s been a privilege to work on Shadowveil, its been an absolute blast to take part of the Legend of the Five Rings universe, and the team and I are eternally grateful to you, our community for supporting us in creating and launching Shadowveil.
 
Thank you for playing Shadowveil: Legend of the Five RIngs, and hopefully we see each other soon in another context. 
Take care and goodbye.

With love,
Filip and the team at Palindrome Interactive

notes.title: Shadowveil Speedrun Contest
notes.content:
[h1]Shadowveil Speedrun Contest[/h1]


Calling all the fastest samurai (and speed demons)! 
The dev team is hosting a Speedrun Contest for Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings, and we want YOU to put your skills and speed to the test!
Whether you’re a seasoned fighter or a new recruit, this is your chance to compete for eternal glory!

[h2]Start date: [/h2][i]Wednesday, April 2.nd, 20.00 CEST[/i]

[h2]Format:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 	Part 1 (24 hours) - Complete Chapter 1 
[*] 	Part 2 (5 days) - Complete Chapter 1-4 
[*] 	Part 3 (10 days) - Complete Chapter 1-9
[/list]
All categories start at the same time, but Part 1 ends 24 hours after the contest starts, part 2 ends after 5 days, and Part 3 ends after 10 days.

[h2]Categories:[/h2]
Any% (Fastest Completion)

[h2]Submission method:[/h2]
Record your run, and upload it to YouTube (a Twitch VOD is approved, if the recording is saved for at least the duration of the event), and submit the video in [[url=https://forms.gle/SQvykr17P8NKeisf7]this link[/url]].

[h2]Prizes:[/h2]
The fastest player in each part will have their chosen alias(*) and represented faction immortalized in the game(**).

* [i]Winning players will pick an in-universe name fitting for Legend of the Five Rings (respecting the setting and naming conventions of the universe). Players can not use the names of named characters in the franchise. The dev team and partners reserve the right to vet names before implementation.[/i]
** [i]The winning players will be named in the game on a permanent “Heroes of the Wall” banner, visible at the Watchtower of Wistful Strife.[/i]

[h2]Eligibility:[/h2]
Runs must be performed on the latest patch of the game.
Mods or external tools that alter gameplay are not allowed
Participants must provide full, unedited video proof (Twitch VOD, YouTube, etc.).
The run must include (but is not limited to) game audio

[h3]Timer Rules:[/h3]
Timing starts when selecting the save slot. Timer ends on the final hit of the last boss (or last chapter completion for All Chapters).
Segmented runs are allowed, but each video must be at least a full chapter. 
We encourage using [url=https://livesplit.org/]LiveSplit[/url] or similar to keep track of your time (LiveSplit can be added as an overlay on top of the gameplay).

[h3]Restrictions:[/h3]
Any%: All skips and exploits allowed unless they crash the game.

[h3]Submission:[/h3]
Submit via [[url=https://forms.gle/SQvykr17P8NKeisf7]this link[/url]] with:
Runner name
Run type (which chapters)
Final time
Video link
Email
Suggested in-universe name

[h2]Fair Play:[/h2]
Cheating, splicing, or falsifying runs results in disqualification.
Disputes will be reviewed by the dev team.

We invite you to discuss strategies, techniques and other related topics in the newly created [url=https://discord.gg/VWzBDDX6Hr]#speedrun[/url] channel in the [url=discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url]

Good luck, and have fun!

notes.title: Shadowveil Patch 1.0.4 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings from Rokugan! [/h1]

We just launched version 1.0.4, and it includes a lot of updates and optimizations. See the full list below!

Shoutout to the player community in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536960]Shadowveil Steam Forum[/url] for providing bug reports, so we can continue to track down and eliminate issues. You're true friends of the Crab Clan!

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] There is a softlock that can happen when entering the Shadowveil and exiting the game to main menu. When in the Shadowveil try to complete the entire path (so you are back on the main map) before exiting the game. This can also happen when using camp in the Shadowveil. For now try to use camp in the main map only. We are looking into hotfixing this next week!
[*] There is rare random crashes during battles which are hard to nail down, as above please report it on discord to help us solve them!
[*] Resolutions with 16:10 or other less common aspect ratios may have issues with the UI
[/list]


[h1]Version number 1.0.4.18507[/h1]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a missing event in earlier versions
[/list]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
The fifth patch brings the fifth optimization package. This time, further work has gone into VFX (details below) and a large rework of how UI is loaded to save RAM and VRAM.
[list]
[*] All VFX in the game has been tweaked to be more performant
[*] Fire effects are now more fiery!
[*] Optimized UI RAM usage.
[/list]

We've changed the rendering mode for many particles from "Translucent" to "Masked" due to how particle-heavy many fights can be later in the game.
Translucent particles cause heavy overdraw (re-rendering areas where they are) due to how rendering works in modern game engines - "Masked" materials, on the other hand, don't have this issue. 
To retain most of the transparency, we use something called "Dithering" (basically fading into dots), which does cause some graininess but is a good trade-off performance-wise.


[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] QoL: Updated descriptions and breakdowns for Berserker's Rage, Besiege, Burning Blossom Trap, Push Trap, Slash, and Earth Becomes Sky
[*] Event Ancient Temple now gives [spoiler]Kakeguchi's Bane at the end of the run[/spoiler]
[*] Changed what text is Header and Support Header in Fortitude Rewards
[*] Changed camera for card rewards depending on act
[*] Changed the skylight and the map FX to reduce rendering issues
[*] Changed so events stores all event options so that the “not selected” exclamation mark is correctly shown
[*] Changed hovering enemies and inspecting shows only relevant stats
[*] Changed so Corrupted Spirits show Evasion instead of Defense on hover
[*] Changed so markers/deployables can no longer be placed on top of each other
[/list]


[h2]Critical Fixes (Crashes/Softlock)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash when that happened on the rare occasion of equipping two eternal items simultaneously. [spoiler]The one selected from embark and Kakeguchi's Bane[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed softlocking issue that disabled players control over moving units
[*] Fixed potential softlock in the tutorial
[*] Fixed a potential softlock in Chapter 6
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Enemy corpses now also become un-interactable when dead
[*] Fixed deck reward packs not showing correctly when there were more than 2 
[*] Fixed so Missions or special nodes now generate the same level content when you retry them
[*] Fixed so Revealing the entire map no longer shows encounters and paths from other acts 
[*] Fixed so that no combine arrow is shown if the item is on a dead unit (as it's locked)
[*] Fixed event hint tooltip showing the "You Receive" header when there are no direct rewards in “A Lost Crab Warrior” event
[*] Fixed issues where certain effects could damage untargetable units causing, issues.
[*] Fixed issue in chapter 5 where multiple bosses appeared present
[*] Fixed ability Shifting Currents cooldown
[*] Fixed issue where victory screen did not show correctly after events
[*] Fixed issues with Challenge “Training Dummy” and “Pessimist”

notes.title: Post-Launch thoughts from the team.
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Soon the first week will have passed since the launch of Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings. The response has been amazing and seeing the community help each other out, strategize, think and execute their best expeditions in true Crab Clan spirit.

I cannot thank everyone enough, its been a true pleasure working on the game and the studio would love to continue supporting it.

On that note, I wanted to delve a bit deeper into what Palindrome have in store.

[h2]QoL and fixes[/h2]

Our main priority since launch has been to monitor the game and Discord to catch crashes and bugs. With your help, we’ve identified and resolved many issues and already pushed the 1.0.1 patch with multiple hotfixes.

[list]
[*] Recent Fixes & Improvements:
[*] Fixed multiple crashes and stability issues
[*] Various hotfixes based on community reports
[/list]

Full details of 1.0.1 can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2536960/announcements/detail/509574242369536157]here (1.0.1 Patch Notes)[/url] 


Beyond that the studio are monitoring feedback for QoL changes. Of course we have a multitude of things we want to tackle, but here are some of items that are on the top of our list

[h3]Upcoming QoL Features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Respec System – Reset and adjust your character builds.
[*] Persistent Game Speed – Your preferred speed settings will carry between battles.
[*] Always-Accessible Inventory – View stats & items anytime.
[*] …and more based on your feedback!
[/list]

[h2]Steamdeck[/h2]

Right now, Shadowveil runs on Steam Deck but lacks controller support, making some UI elements difficult to navigate.

Palindrome are committed to getting Steam Deck Verified, but this requires:
[list]
[*] ✅ UI & UX optimizations for better readability
[*] ✅ Full controller support
[*] ✅ Further performance tuning
[/list]

For now, our top priority is stability and core fixes, but Steam Deck improvements will follow.

I want to be clear that this is a personal goal for me, so hang in tight, show us the support you can and the studio will work hard for it!

[h2]Content and DLC[/h2]

While the studio are still exploring larger content updates, here’s what we can confirm is coming soon:

[list]
[*] 🧙 Unique portraits for all hero characters
[*] 🗿    Updated models for the Lost Library Guardians
[*] 👀 More ways to increase the depth of your strategies!
[/list]

This is the most exciting avenue for Shadowveil but we are still in the early stages and can't promise much. Similar to the Steamdeck this is a larger undertaking that will take more time. I know how many of you want more cards, difficulty options or even a new Clan. But fret not I am in the same camp but it's to early to confirm anything. However make your voice heard, share the game, leave a review and if you have ideas please share them in the discord!

 

I hope this post shines some light on what Palindrome are working on and why. Again thank you for all support, the team and I are so happy about having such an amazing community. 
We’d love to hear your thoughts! Join us in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536960]Shadowveil Steam Discussion[/url] or in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url] to share your feedback on future content.

If you’re enjoying Shadowveil, consider [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2536960/Shadowveil_Legend_of_The_Five_Rings/]leaving a review[/url][/b], it helps us a lot!
Our wall still stands!



With love
Filip - Game Director

notes.title: Launch Day Update (1.0.0 Patch Notes)
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings from Rokugan! [/h1]

Launch Day is upon us, and we'd like to share the list of changes and fixes we've implemented for the full version of Shadowveil. A shoutout to the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Discord community[/url] and the players on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536960]Shadowveil Steam Forum[/url] who has helped nail down some of the issues during the duration of the demo. You can still enjoy the standalone demo for a bit longer, as it has been received very positively. However as our focus will transition to the full game, the demo will [b]NOT[/b] be updated for a while. There are known issues, performance issues and crashes with the demo that is fixed in the full game (again shoutout to the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Discord community[/url] and the players on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536960]Shadowveil Steam Forum[/url]), which we want to implement in the demo eventually!

(04.03.2025)[/h1]
[h3]Exact version number: 1.0.0.17846[/h3]
Spoiler warning: Potential spoilers are listed with spoiler tags: [spoiler]like this[/spoiler]. 

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the full game, defeat the evil forces of the Shadowlands and make the Crab Clan proud!
[*] Added full localization (text only) for French, Italian, German, Spanish(Spain), Portuguese(Brazil) and Simplified Chinese 
[*] Added new music to camp

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
This is the first optimization package for the game, while there is work still to be done, this will lower usage of RAM and VRAM significantly, improving performance but most importantly eliminating a majority of crashes reported during the demo.
[list]
[*] Enabled LODs for most objects in-game
[*] Optimized the most commonly used shaders to be more performant
[*] Optimized texture sizes for nonvirtual textures
[*] Optimized textures and shaders for streaming
[*] Improved performance with low and medium global illumination settings. This should lessen the abnormal GPU usage for some GPUs

[*] Updated shrine visuals

[*] Updated various card hovers that did not autoscroll

[*] Fixed an empty keyword that made it look like the ability Bind spirit had other keywords
[*] Fixed an issue where loading into a mission map didn't fade to black correctly

Before we start the list, we'd like to thank you for playing the demo and/or following the game's development. It has been super fun seeing the response from the community and we are working hard to alleviate the issues that has been reported.

We've included the known issues at the bottom of the list, that are [b]A:[/b] either not resolved yet ([b]in bold[/b]), or [i]B[/i] simply haven't made it into today's update ([i]in cursive[/i]). 

Feel free to let us know if you encounter any of the issues in category [b]A[/b]. You can do so by submitting them in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url]: [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R[/url]

(Note this is an ongoing process and we will continue with this for launch and beyond)
[/list]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added audio focus option, you can now have background audio enabled.
[*] Added save backup system to avoid total loss if save game is corrupted
[*] Added a button to dismiss non-unique units in barracks
[/list]

[h3]Updated[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated balance to match the player data we have gathered the last 2 weeks
[*] Updated subheader fonts
[*] Updated card description font to be more readable at a glance. Also increased contrast
[*] Updated [spoiler]Madōshi Corruptors'[/spoiler] “mind control.” It now stuns instead of making units switch sides
[*] Updated event rewards and art
[*] Updated challenge rewards
[*] Updated Cardviewer to reflect unlocks better
[*] Player can now drag and drop units during combat barks
[*] Combat level should now always be the same when retrying
[*] Updated traps to use titles instead of healthbars
[*] Updated titles for deployables
[*] Updated how the act title is displayed
[*] Updated enemies closer to the wall
[*] Updated blessings and other rewards should now be showcased in the reward flow
[*] Updated upgrade button on cards to be more visible
[*] Updated mission popup to showcase speaker
[*] Updated barracks character bar scroll
[*] You can no longer have negative jade
[*] Updated quest UI to support multistage missions better
[*] Updated scroll speed on some elements
[*] Updated dialogue system to be more consistent in how clicks work
[*] Updated system of how boss levels are loaded to resolve some crashes
[/list]

[h3]Critical fixes (crashes/softlocks)[/h3]
[list]

[*] Fixed a crash when loading a save file on a mission map
[*] Fixed a crash when loading a save file related to mission nodes
[*] Fixed a crash when the [spoiler]Oni lord[/spoiler] used abilities
[*] Fixed an issue that could crash the game when the [spoiler]Oni lord[/spoiler] attacked
[*] Fixed an issue where returning to a boss would softlock the player
[*] Fixed an issue where players got softlocked in the tutorial
[*] Fixed an issue where players got softlocked entering the tutorial boss
[*] Fixed an issue where players got softlocked from narrative barks
[*] Fixed an issue where boss levels could be streamed in incorrectly, leading to a softlock
[*] Fixed an issue with softlocks regarding the event “Conquer yourself”
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple instances of the camp screen could be accessed
[*] Fixed an issue where completing Kuni emissary did not unlock the emissary building

notes.title: Animation Spotlight for Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings from Rokugan! Today we're sitting down for a talk with Atle, who's an animator on Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings.[/h3]

[h2]Would you like to introduce yourself?[/h2]
My name is Atle Fägersten and I am the animator at Palindrome Interactive. I was one of the founders of Palindrome Interactive back in 2015 and has since then had a bunch of different roles from generalist to producer but for Shadowveil: Legend of The Five Rings I am fully focused on animation!


[h2]Can you share your initial inspiration for these specific animations?[/h2]
Our style was inspired by different “limited animation” styles. Limited animation is often used in anime to reduce the cost of animation but in our case it is more used to create impactful movements and add the jarring feeling of the Shadowlands to our animations.  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UKFOQHQ.gif[/img]

[h2]What references or real-life movements influenced the style and feel of the animations?[/h2]
Lots of references from traditional martial arts were used as inspirations for many of the animations. But with our style and camera angle, those traditional movements often needed to be exaggerated in order to be interesting. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/br3pIYN.gif[/img]

[h2]On the more technical side of things, which animation software or tools did you use to create these sequences? How do you decide on keyframes, timing, transitions and such, to achieve this type of movement?[/h2]
The two biggest parts in achieving this look is: 
Stepped interpolation: Normally when animating in 3D your software will interpolate between keyframes to create smooth motions. For this style we go instantly from one pose to the next. 
No in-between poses: Traditionally when doing big movements you will add poses between the two extremes to create a movement that flows well and is readable. For this style we go directly from one extreme to the other (sometimes making an exception and having one in-between pose for 1 frame). 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mbtpHEe.gif[/img]

[h2]What was the most challenging aspect of creating these animations (and how did you overcome it)?[/h2]
It is quite a different style to work with as you need to find the right balance between the time between poses and change from pose to pose. Too short of time between not enough movement and you start to lose that stepped feel. Too much time between too large of a movement and it becomes impossible to follow. Through trial and error I was able to figure out some base guidelines for what would work. 

[h2]Were there any particular character traits or design constraints that made the animation process more complex?[/h2]
I don’t want to spoil too much but working on characters of different scales, especially bigger characters, added an extra level of complexity as they move at different speeds. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4dTRgv5.gif[/img]

Thank you, Atle, for sharing! 

For more updates on Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings, be sure to follow the game here on Steam and check out our socials (linked below).

What’s it like working every day on the Legend of the Five Rings franchise? [/h3]
I think it's quite an honor and a very interesting task to work with Legend of the Five Rings. 
"The Franchise is brimming with lore from the AEG days, when the card game was revolutionary for letting fans decide the path of the story, and the Fantasy Flight Games era when that tradition continued through the LCG as well as the RPG." 
What we are working with is the new Clan Wars era, heavily inspired by the original Legend of the Five Rings storyline drawn from the tournaments and player choices. However, this will not be the exact same story from the AEG days, nor is it a direct continuation of the tale told alongside FFG’s LCG. 
A prime example of course is Shadowveil, taking beloved characters and setting them on an adventure that we hope will delight existing fans of the franchise but also serve as a vehicle for new people to discover and experience this great universe. As you might imagine, working with this is sometimes daunting, but I am confident and happy to work with Legend of the Five Rings each and every day. 

[h3]What aspects of the Legend of the Five Rings lore and world-building make it an interesting IP for a creative project like a video game? [/h3]
I think it's the sheer size of the universe. One could make basically any type of game set in Rokugan focusing on a specific clan or family. That's a very exciting prospect when starting a game project like Shadowveil. Some have asked us about the focus on the Crab Clan, asking whether we might be missing out on many of the other great things in the rest of Rokugan. I think it's a great question, but that is also the point of Shadowveil. It's a perfect stepping stone for new fans to get into the vast universe that Legend of the Five Rings presents. A regular good vs. evil setting is often used as a prologue to set the stakes, before politics is introduced and complex characters are put against each other. Often that leads to great interest in what comes next, and I think everyone here and fans want Legend of the Five Rings video games to continue after Shadowveil. 

[h3]How does the unique blend of fantasy and samurai culture in Legend of the Five Rings offer opportunities for innovative storytelling and game design? [/h3]
Well, I think the resurgence of roleplaying games shows that fantasy has a significant staying power. Legend of the Five Rings’s twist of course is that it's not only fantasy but also greatly inspired by feudal Japan and other Asian cultures. This creates an intricate world filled with mysteries and lore and, as I described above, it's so vast that you can go anywhere and find something new. This gives a fantastic toolbox to craft Shadowveil into a unique experience in not only its setting but also in its gameplay. Do we use existing abilities established in the card
game or TTRPG? Or do we try to figure out something new and cool that fits the video game? Those questions are what makes Legend of the Five Rings so fun to work with. 

[h3]What are some challenges working with the intricate political dynamics and clan relationships in Legend of the Five Rings? [/h3]
Again the sheer scale of it, and I think that's exactly why we wanted to focus on a couple of characters to be more approachable for both old and new fans. Being able to figure out a part of the world through the eyes of Hida Sukune or Hida O-Ushi helps us focus the lens on their relationship and their struggle to prove themselves to their father. I think this game will establish some of the groundwork for preparing the fans of the franchise for the storm that is approaching with the Clan Wars. 

[h3]What interesting considerations have you and the team done when crafting a digital Shadowlands-experience? [/h3]
I think in Shadowveil we have included multiple twists and turns to make this a fully unique experience. There has been thought put into each aspect of how we portray the Shadowlands in the best manner possible. This effort should be visible throughout the game, from the world map
that you use navigate from battle to battle, from the stepped animation style, where we aim to
create a disjointing feeling of corruption, to the increase in Shadowlands Taint as you travel deeper into the Shadowlands and the unique ways to use Cards to give your characters abilities and behaviors to face any of the minions of Fu Leng.
